In mathematics, the '''monopole moduli space''' is a space parametrizing monopoles (solutions of the [[Bogomolny equations]]).  {{harvs|txt|last=Atiyah|last2=Hitchin|year=1988}} studied the [[moduli space]] for 2 monopoles in detail and used it to describe the scattering of monopoles.
